'''''Invictibellatrix''''' ([[Latin]]: "unconquered warrior") is an [[extinct]] genus of [[megaraptora]]n theropod dinosaur known from the [[Early Cretaceous]] ([[Barremian]] age) [[Wessex Formation]] of England. The genus contains a [[Monotypic taxon|single species]], '''''Invictibellatrix amberina''''', known from a single braincase.<ref name="Invictibellatrix" />

== Discovery and naming ==
[[File:Invictibellatrix amberina.png|thumb|Life reconstruction]]
The ''Invictibellatrix'' fossil material was discovered in outcrops of the [[Wessex Formation]] on the [[Isle of Wight]], United Kingdom. The specimen is housed in the [[Natural History Museum, London|Natural History Museum]] in [[London]], where it is permanently [[Accession number (cultural property)|accessioned]] as specimen NHMUK PV R 6775. It was sold to the museum in May 1924 by the widow of the collector [[Reginald Hooley|Reginald Walter Hooley]]. It consists of an isolated [[braincase]] (part of the skull that houses the brain).<ref name="Invictibellatrix" /> Prior to the formal naming of ''Invictibellatrix'', the fossil material was reported in a [[Academic conference|conference]] [[Abstract (summary)|abstract]] in 2024.<ref name="EAVP2024" /> In 2026, Cassius Morrison and colleagues [[Species description|described]] ''Invictibellatrix amberina'' as a new genus and species of megaraptoran theropod based on these fossil remains, designating NHMUK PV R 6775 as the [[holotype]] specimen.<ref name="Invictibellatrix" />

== Description ==
''Invictibellatrix'' is estimated to have a body mass between {{cvt|200–300|kg}} and a body length of around {{cvt|4|m}}.<ref name="Invictibellatrix" />

Three [[autapomorphies]] were established, unique derived traits. On each side of the parabasisphenoíd in front of the ''recessus tympanicus anterior'', a small ''recessus basipterygoideus'' is present. The crest on the back of the skull is lightly tranvsersely compressed and has an hourglass profile. On the crest distinctive lightly curved depressions are present on the midline.<ref name="Invictibellatrix" />
